units.source_text: 左大臣目送源氏公子出门后，

en.t: After the Minister of the Left watched Prince Genji leave,

units.source_text: 回到公子旧居的房间里，

en.t: he returned to the room in the prince's former residence,

units.source_text: 但见室中自装饰以至一切布置，全同葵姬生前一样，毫无变动。

en.t: and saw that everything in the room, from the decorations to all the furnishings, was exactly as it had been while Lady Aoi was alive, without the slightest change.

units.source_text: 然而空洞无主，仿佛蜕去后的蝉壳。

en.t: Yet it was hollow and without its mistress, like the empty shell left behind by a cicada.

units.source_text: 案上散置着笔砚等物，又有公子所弃置的墨稿。

en.t: On the desk lay brushes, an inkstone, and other things scattered about, along with drafts in ink that the prince had left aside.
The Minister of the Left picked them up and looked them over.

units.source_text: 泪眼昏花，难于分辨，只得努力眨眼，将泪水挤出。

en.t: His tear-filled eyes were blurred, making it hard to make anything out, so he had to blink hard to force the tears away.

units.source_text: 众青年侍女看到这模样，觉得滑稽，悲哀之中不禁微笑起来。

en.t: The young ladies-in-waiting saw him like this, found it somewhat funny, and despite their sorrow could not help smiling.

units.source_text: 这些墨稿之中，有缠绵悱恻的古诗，有汉文的，也有日文的。

en.t: Among these ink drafts were deeply moving old poems, some in Chinese and some in Japanese.

units.source_text: 无论汉字或假名，都有种种体裁，新颖秀美。

en.t: Whether written in Chinese characters or in kana, they showed many styles, all fresh, elegant, and beautiful.

units.source_text: 左大臣叹道：“真乃心灵手巧！”

en.t: The Minister of the Left sighed in admiration, "What a truly gifted mind and hand!"
He looked up at the sky and sank deep into thought.

units.source_text: 心念如此英才，今后将成为外人，岂不可惜！

en.t: Thinking that such an extraordinary talent would now become a stranger to them, he felt it was unbearably regrettable.

units.source_text: 只见源氏公子在“旧枕故衾谁与共？”这句诗旁写着：

en.t: Then he saw that Prince Genji had written beside the line, "With whom shall I share the old pillow and old quilt?":
